description: Physical access authorizations are not developed, approved, and maintained for individuals requiring access to facilities.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing physical access authorization lists, unapproved or outdated access lists, lack of review processes, missing authorization credentials, and inadequate processes for removing access when no longer required.
